subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth is reading Zalthir’s mind and suggests taking the boat from the Kuo-Toans, recalling a near-sacrifice while selling them weapons.
source_quote: Maybe we take that boat from them? Like the last time I talked to Kuo-Toans, I almost got sacrificed. I was just trying to sell them weapons. I didn’t think they would think sacrificing me was a weapon. Crazy fish people.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar has decided that talking with more Kuo-Toans is the right course of action and is visibly excited, appearing so to Zalthir.
source_quote: Talking with more Kuotoans is the right answer. Shuushar is very excited; at least, it would appear to Zalthir, Shuushar’s excited.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir steps back and prepares to attack, anticipating potential danger.
source_quote: Zalthir steps back and gets ready to attack, just in case.

subject: The Awakened
fact: The Awakened shouts out to his kinsmen, rallying them as the group prepares to depart.
source_quote: The Awakened shouts out to his kinsmen.

subject: Kuo-Toan Companion
fact: The Kuo-Toan companion reveals they are from Sloobludop, have witnessed the madness of their kind, and seek to create a better Kuo-Toan world free from divine-driven insanity.
source_quote: They are from Sloobludop and have seen the danger of the Kuo-Toan madness. And they are receptive to my message! They want to create a better Kuo-Toan world where we are no longer driven mad by our need to create a new god! I have found my calling! And I must leave you!

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin interrupts Zalthir’s concern about Shuushar’s insight into the Darklake map and urges, 'Follow your bliss!'

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar turns to his fellow escapees and thanks them, declaring he has found his people and will build a better world.
source_quote: I have found my people, and we will build a better world!

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin gives Zalthir a tearful hug during the farewell.
source_quote: the tearful goodbye of Thorin, who is giving him a hug

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum spits into the lake as part of the group’s farewell ritual.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz looks indifferent during the emotional farewell.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar says 'thank you!' as the other Kuo-Toan boat floats away.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith murmurs doubt about following Shuushar’s instructions, unsure he can execute them correctly.
source_quote: Erm, guys, I have Shuushar’s instructions, but I am not so sure I can follow them correctly.

subject: Kuo-Toans
fact: The Kuo-Toans are a collective known for madness driven by divine imperative, with factions seeking to escape or reform their destructive cycle.
source_quote: They are from Sloobludop and have seen the danger of the Kuo-Toan madness... driven mad by our need to create a new god!

subject: Dark Lake
fact: The Dark Lake is a significant location where farewells occur, and where Shuushar’s instructions are to be followed.
source_quote: As they stare into the Dark Lake, Sarith mutters...

subject: Shuushar’s Instructions
fact: Shuushar’s instructions remain ambiguous and potentially unexecutable, casting doubt on the group’s next steps.
source_quote: I have Shuushar’s instructions, but I am not so sure I can follow them correctly.

subject: Kuo-Toan Boat
fact: A Kuo-Toan boat floats away as the group departs, symbolizing transition and departure from their former path.
source_quote: As the other Kuo-Toan boat floats off, Shuushar says thank you!

subject: Farewell at Dark Lake
fact: A collective farewell occurs at the Dark Lake, marked by emotional gestures, indifference, and the departure of a Kuo-Toan companion.
source_quote: Zalthir stands off as he watches the tearful goodbye of Thorin, who is giving him a hug, Grygum spitting into the lake, and Daz looking indifferent.
